import json, re, pathlib
from pathlib import Path

pyproject_path = Path('/inputs/pyproject.toml')
base_path = Path('/inputs/devcontainer.json')
out_path = Path('/work/devcontainer.json')

# Read pyproject and extract [project] name
text = pyproject_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
project_name = None
in_project = False
for line in text.splitlines():
    s=line.strip()
    if s.startswith('[') and s.endswith(']'):
        in_project = (s == '[project]')
        continue
    if in_project:
        m = re.match(r'name\s*=\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']\s*$', s)
        if m:
            project_name = m.group(1)
            break
if project_name is None:
    raise RuntimeError('Could not find project.name in /inputs/pyproject.toml')

slug = project_name.lower().replace(' ', '-').replace('_', '-')

base_text = base_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
# Replace placeholders globally in raw text first
replaced_text = base_text.replace('{{PROJECT_NAME}}', project_name).replace('{{PROJECT_SLUG}}', slug)

obj = json.loads(replaced_text)

# Append python extensions after existing entries
exts = obj['customizations']['vscode']['extensions']
exts.extend([
    'ms-python.python',
    'ms-python.vscode-pylance',
    'charliermarsh.ruff'
])

settings = obj['customizations']['vscode']['settings']
settings['python.defaultInterpreterPath'] = '.venv/bin/python'
settings['[python]'] = {
    'editor.defaultFormatter': 'charliermarsh.ruff',
    'editor.codeActionsOnSave': {
        'source.organizeImports': 'explicit'
    }
}

obj['postCreateCommand'] = 'rm -rf .venv && uv sync && uv run /opt/post_install.py'

# Write valid JSON UTF-8
out_path.write_text(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')

# Validate by reading back
json.loads(out_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

print('WROTE', out_path)
print('PROJECT_NAME', project_name)
print('SLUG', slug)
